definitions.explanation: describing a relationship where contact has become rare or the emotional distance has grown

examples.japanese: {兄|あに}とは{疎遠|そえん}になった。
examples.english: I've become estranged from my older brother.

examples.japanese: {疎遠|そえん}になっていた{友人|ゆうじん}から{連絡|れんらく}があった。
examples.english: I got a call from a friend I'd lost touch with.

examples.japanese: {引|ひ}っ{越|こ}してから{親戚|しんせき}とは{疎遠|そえん}になりがちだ。
examples.english: Since moving, I tend to lose touch with relatives.

notes:
FORMATION:
{疎|そ} (distant, sparse) + {遠|えん} (far) → distant and far

GRAMMAR:
{疎遠|そえん}になる (to become estranged)
{疎遠|そえん}な{関係|かんけい} (an estranged relationship)

RELATED WORDS:
- {絶縁|ぜつえん} (breaking ties completely - stronger)
- {疎|うと}い (estranged, unfamiliar)
- {親|した}しい (close, intimate - opposite)
- {遠|とお}ざかる (to grow distant)

DISTINCTION:
{疎遠|そえん} implies a gradual drifting apart, often without active hostility. {絶縁|ぜつえん} implies a deliberate cutting of ties, often due to conflict.
